data.text:
# Correction to the position recorded for attempt 8 at record 82

The field this attempt added says which slice of the plan a proved slice is, so
that the tdd gate holds it to that slice's route rather than to whichever slice
happens to sit at the same index. Record 82 names position 4, and attempt 8 does
not belong to slice 4.

**What attempt 8 actually reworked.** The gate's mapping in harness/gates.py,
which is slice 2's file; the stale-route read in harness/kpi.py and the division
in harness/context.py, which are slice 4's; and the route entry in
harness/routing.py, which is slice 1's. Four findings of the fourth review
across three slices' files.

**What the record should have said.** Nothing. The field is omittable, and the
gate is explicit that a record naming no position is held to no route, because
the mapping it never carried cannot be inferred. A rework round that spans
slices is exactly the case omission is for, and the session wrote a number
anyway, one attempt after adding the field for the sake of not guessing.

**What follows from it.** With `[routing] shadow` true nothing compares, so no
check was held to the wrong route and no advance turned on the value. Had shadow
been false, the three checks of this attempt declared `--model opus` and slice 4
is routed sonnet, so the gate would have refused them: the value would have
caused the refusal the field exists to prevent, on this ticket's own record.

**What it says about the field.** A rework round having no single position is
not an edge case, it is most rounds after the first, and the harness has one
answer for it: leave the field out. That reading belongs in the template's own
prose rather than in a note, and it is not in this ticket's scope to add. The
next ticket that touches harness/templates/tdd.json should say it there.
